Taxes, Other Than Income
Taxes, other than income, increased by $17 million in 2007 compared with 2006. 
The increase was primarily due to: l a $12 million increase in domestic gross receipts tax expense, which is passed through to customers, resulting from a 4% increase in sales volume; l a $5 million increase from changes in U.K. foreign currency exchange rates; and l a $4 million increase in WPD property taxes, attributable to a $2 million refund credit in 2006 and inflation; partially offset by l a $4 million decrease in domestic capital stock tax expense. Other Income – net
